title: `BETWEEN .03 AND .06` is parsed as identifiers instead of keywords
spec:
This is the sqlparse library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests`.

```python
import sqlparse
p = sqlparse.parse('a BETWEEN .03 AND .06')[0]
[(t.ttype, t.value) for t in p.flatten() if not t.is_whitespace]
```
Expected: `[(Token.Name, 'a'), (Token.Keyword, 'BETWEEN'), (Token.Literal.Number.Float, '.03'), (Token.Keyword, 'AND'), (Token.Literal.Number.Float, '.06')]`
Actual: `BETWEEN` and `AND` come out as `Token.Name`, and `p.tokens` groups them into identifiers `'a BETWEEN'` and `'.03 AND'`.

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
